ready1_open_rewrite.raw_question_text: As shown in the figure, in $\triangle ABF$, $\angle AFB=90^\circ$. The vertex $E$ of $\triangle CDE$ is on the side $BF$ of $\triangle ABF$, point $C$ is on the extension of $BF$, $\angle C=\angle B$, and $CD=CE$. If $\angle A=36^\circ$, what is the degree measure of $\angle D$?
ready1_open_rewrite.raw_answer_text:
\textbf{Solution:} In right triangle $ABF$, $\angle B=90^\circ-\angle A=90^\circ-36^\circ=54^\circ$,\\
$\therefore \angle C=\angle B=54^\circ$.\\
Because $CD=CE$,\\
$\therefore \angle D=\angle DEC$,\\
In triangle $CDE$,\\
$\angle C+\angle D+\angle DEC=180^\circ$,\\
$\therefore \angle D=\boxed{63^\circ}$.
